413-862-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
413-862-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. When Crimson Kobolds enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

972-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
972-4881-6909.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1651-4094-4231-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4094-4231-4732-5261.description:
Activate Kaya by removing two loyalty counters from her, doubling the number of tokens you create this turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7159.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

5478-6441-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
5478-6441-6753-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4364-5686-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-5686-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4770-7399.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3375-4399-4518-7399.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1753-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1753-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1753-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1308-2506-4836-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

5641-7173-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-7173-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4506-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4506-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

280-1558-3129-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-3129-3875-4231.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4460-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

698-2060-4770-6930.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've gained this turn.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2

1292-2510-3117-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1292-2510-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

640-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1894-2403-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2853-4996-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 12 if Beacon of Immortality is in your library, or you have {5}{W} available if it's in your hand.
2853-4996-6900.description:
Activate Thought Lash by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you either exile your library or have Beacon of Immortality on top of your library.
Resolve all Thought Lash abilities.
Cast Beacon of Immortality either from your hand by paying {5}{W} or from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
If Beacon of Immortality is not on top of your library, repeat from step 1. Otherwise, repeat step 4.

1395-2604-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

573-654-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-654-5451-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

945-1303-5231.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {B}{B}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken Relentless Dead, adding {R}.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger. Choose not to pay for either.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the token Relentless Dead, adding {R}.
When the token Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3389-5921-5954-6664.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-3951-5703-5929.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3129-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1651-3459-5469.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating your choice of a Clue, Food or Blood artifact token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the token and Battered Golem, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1987-2468-2751-4002.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Sceptre of Eternal Glory and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2921-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1479-3585-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-3585-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2757-3525-6210.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Neerdiv.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

67-2525-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability.
Repeat.

946-1744-3096-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
946-1744-3096-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Twisted Image by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Twisted Image targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Twisted Image, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

3094-3609-3933-4868.manaNeeded: {6} each odd-numbered turn, with {4} available each even-numbered turn
3094-3609-3933-4868.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
3094-3609-3933-4868.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's Bastion's ability.
Resolve both Karn's Bastion abilities, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one time.
Repeat from step 1.

1-751-2430-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Shrieking Drake.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling Shrieking Drake and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Shrieking Drake from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Shrieking Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

3099-3767-4587-4893.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
3099-3767-4587-4893.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
